title: Jude and the Autopsy
author: Sebastian Coldharbour
blurb: Mara Quintana, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
